'''''Orrian''''' was a [[Cargo ferry]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
Orrian', along with sister ship ''[[Lundi]]'' and [[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|MC40a light cruiser]] [[Condor (MC40a light cruiser)|''Condor'']] were to rendezvous with [[Airam (group)|Airam]] forces lead by [[Clan leader]] [[Tamaron]] to replenish the Rebel's [[Warhead/Legends|Warhead]] supply at his [[Asteroid Hangar]] ''[[Attila]]''. However rival Airam forces lead by [[Ilay]], a clan leader sympathetic to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], sent [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] from Bravo to disrupt the meeting. [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] intercepted the T-wings, however, [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] and [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Wasp (Imperial-class)|''Wasp'']] soon arrived. Both Rebel squadrons held out long enough for the transfers to be completed and all ships to enter [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]
